title: Keep Default main ad hoc session changes for review

intentCoverage.report:
# Dough Intent Coverage: one fault probe

**Verdict: Caught.** With the landed context removed from a Done ad hoc session's review, the maintained assertion `expectLandedContext` (`dashboard/tests/storyReviewPages.ts:64`, the "Landed run" heading expectation), called from `dashboard/frontend-tests/sessions/recently-done-ad-hoc-review.spec.ts:100` (phase "the panel shows the session's landed review"), failed on independently observed wrong behavior. The claim is limited to this path: a standalone ad hoc Done entry in Recently done, set up through `openFrontendBoardReview({ doneSessions })`, opened with **Review changes**, in the frontend suite with a substituted review answer.

**Next proof action:** none needed for this promise on this path; the consolidated `doneSessions` setup still reaches the landed review and its assertion still bites. No repair decision arises from this probe.

## Evidence

- **Story:** SEED-379#keep-default-main-session-changes-for-review (`.planning/seeds/SEED-379-review-changes-from-completed-ad-hoc-sessions.md`, "Keep Default main ad hoc session changes for review"; plan `.planning/slice-plans/693-keep-default-main-session-changes-for-review/PLAN.md`).
- **Revision:** `fe04022a7f36772d930ba27e4853f34e8fce674b`, in a detached scratch worktree at `/Users/terryyin/.claude/jobs/92b5c8a8/tmp/intent-coverage-379` (clean before the probe; own `npm`, `browser`, `check` setup stages all completed).
- **Promise checked (caller's suggestion, validated and kept):** the supplier promise this story builds on and whose spec setup the execution consolidated: on a completed standalone ad hoc session's entry in Recently done, **Review changes** opens that session's retained landed comparison (landed context and changed files); a session without a retained comparison shows its explanation. The story's dependency block records exactly this condition as satisfied by `recently-done-ad-hoc-review.spec.ts`.
- **Fault (one, product code only; fixtures and assertions untouched):** `dashboard/src/StoryReviewContext.tsx`, in `ReviewContext`, one line added before the landed branch: `if (review?.kind === "landed") return null;` so a landed review renders no landed context. This is the caller's "drop the landed context" variant, chosen over the `storyComparisonShown.ts` variant because the context is what the spec asserts directly.
- **Command (caller's suggestion, kept; one addition):** `env -u NO_COLOR -u FORCE_COLOR -u GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES caffeinate -s -i npx playwright test --config dashboard/frontend.playwright.config.ts dashboard/frontend-tests/sessions/recently-done-ad-hoc-review.spec.ts dashboard/frontend-tests/sessions/recently-done-ad-hoc-review-gaps.spec.ts`. Because the strict reporter is silent on pass, I added `OPEN_DOUGH_DASHBOARD_FRONTEND_PROOF_RECORD=<file outside the repository>` to each recorded run to prove the checks were exercised; reporter and timeouts unchanged.
- **Checks examined:** the 4 tests of those two specs: "a standalone ad hoc Done entry opens its review from Review changes", "an ad hoc review explains not captured", "... unreadable repository", "... an empty comparison".

## Run observations

- **Baseline (reach):** exit 0 twice (once plain, once with the proof record). Proof record: phase completed, 4 selected, 4 passed (1142, 758, 827, 570 ms).
- **Fault run:** exit 1. Proof record: 4 selected; the standalone-entry test failed (5732 ms, the 5000 ms default expect wait); the three gaps tests passed. Failure: `expect(locator).toBeVisible()` for `getByRole('region', { name: /(?:Story|Session) review/ }).getByRole('heading', { name: 'Landed run', exact: true })`, element not found, at `dashboard/tests/storyReviewPages.ts:64`. The earlier assertions in the same phase (`expectStory`, `expectSession`) had passed, so the journey reached the session's review panel through the consolidated setup before failing.
- **Wrong behavior, observed independently of the assertion:** the run's page snapshot (`error-context.md`) shows region "Session review" with heading "Open Dough session", session id `open-dough-session-session`, "1 changed file", and "Modified delivered.txt" with `+after`, and no "Landed run" heading, launch time, remote target, base or revision anywhere in the panel. The session's review opened on the intended path with its landed context missing.
- **Gaps specs under this fault:** they passed and this establishes nothing about them. Two use `landing-unavailable` answers the fault does not touch; the empty-comparison test does render a `landed` review with the context dropped, but it asserts only the title, the empty-comparison text and no changed files. Whether an empty comparison's landed context is promised was not examined; that is outside this single probe.
- **Restoration:** `git checkout -- dashboard/src/StoryReviewContext.tsx` in the scratch worktree; `git status --porcelain` empty and no diff against `fe04022a7`, matching the pre-probe state. Same command rerun: exit 0, proof record 4 selected, 4 passed (1417, 654, 575, 775 ms). Scratch worktree then removed (`git worktree remove --force`; no longer listed) and the proof-record files deleted. Nothing was written in the repository, the execution worktree or planning records; no stash used.
- **Prior disposition:** none matched; no planned repair is involved.

## Cost

- **Test runtime.** About 24.6 s wall clock in total (measured with shell `time` around the Playwright command): baseline 7.9 s (includes the first app build) and 4.0 s (with proof record), fault run 8.4 s, restored run 4.3 s. Machine load average was about 7 at the start, with other sessions possibly running.
- **Human effort.** Unavailable: no human took part in the probe and no separate measure of the requester's time exists.
- **Agent effort.** 9 tool operations before this finisher (measured, counted from this run); token usage unavailable, since the agent has no reading of its own token meter.


- **Invocation-to-report elapsed.** 102347 ms (measured), from 1794994288982 to 1794994391329 in Unix epoch ms. The end clock was sampled after writing the prepared report body.

## Wrap-up disposition

Checked revision `fe04022a7f36772d930ba27e4853f34e8fce674b`: Caught; no follow-up.
